definition.peak_basis: Section 2.3 compares positive peaks for all three components; Section 3.1 describes the positive surge, sway and yaw peaks. Fixed samples at -L/2, 0 and L/2 are not a peak search.
definition.reference_series_basis: Sections 3.1 and 3.2 compare both double-body and free-surface numerical models with model tests; the experimental series is selected as the reference, not either numerical model.

stagger_window.basis: A full peak-search interval is not established in the opened paper text; no interval or number is read from a figure.

definition.L: mean ship length, 100 m for the equal-length candidate hulls in model.json
definition.D: draft, 6.17 m for both candidate hulls in model.json
definition.rho: water density; 1025 kg/m^3 is an assumed study input in model.json, not an experimental density established from the paper
definition.V: F_L * sqrt(g * L), from the length Froude definition in Section 2.4
definition.SI_conversion: Fx = Cx * 0.5 * rho * D * L * V^2; Fy = Cy * 0.5 * rho * D * L * V^2; M = Cm * 0.5 * rho * D * L^2 * V^2. Comparison is performed in coefficients, not SI.

absolute_floor_basis.basis: Original SI floors divided by Equation (9) scales at the assumed model base speed of 5 knots; speed_ms uses input_schemas.py conversion. These fixed dimensionless floors apply to every candidate, not candidate-level tolerances.

status: not ready: numerical references and peak-search stagger window not established
basis: Proposed 5% study tolerance from the existing analytical test convention, not experimental uncertainty. No plot digitisation and no published benchmark comparison.
